The document does not cover the compliance, pricing or tech-stack sections that this page already has, so those are left exactly as they are rather than emptied.

The service bullets are the document's exact sentences. An earlier draft of this payload shortened most of them — dropping "and experiences", "overall", "potential customers" — which is an edit to approved copy that nobody asked for.
